records.jp: 前回みたいなすごい降灰じゃなくてよかった。<CR>視界が塞がれるの、地味にストレス溜まるし
records.en_original: I'm glad there's not another crazy Ash storm like last time. Having our vision blocked like that is honestly pretty stressful.
records.en: I'm glad there's not another crazy Ash storm like last time.<CR>Having our vision blocked like that is honestly pretty stressful.

records.jp: ユキ……
records.en_original: Yuki...
records.en: Yuki...

records.jp: メイ、どうした？　なんか元気なさそうだけど
records.en_original: Mei, what's wrong? You don't seem like your usual self.
records.en: Mei, what's wrong? You don't seem like your usual self.

records.jp: いや、私は普段通りだが……
records.en_original: No, I'm the same as always...
records.en: No, I'm the same as always...

records.jp: 本当？
records.en_original: Really?
records.en: Really?

records.jp: ……ユキに隠し事はできないな
records.en_original: I just can't keep secrets from you, can I?
records.en: I just can't keep secrets from you, can I?

records.jp: 実は最近、リーダーと<CR>話す時間が減ったような気がするんだ
records.en_original: Actually, lately it feels like I haven't been able to talk with Leader as much.
records.en: Actually, I feel like I haven't had as much time<CR>to talk with Leader lately.

records.jp: 以前はもっと、任務のこととか、作戦のこととか<CR>私に相談してくれたような気がする
records.en_original: I feel like Leader used to confide in me more about missions and strategies.
records.en: I feel like Leader used to confide in me more<CR>about missions and strategies.

records.jp: リーダーだけでなく、みんなもだ。<CR>以前ほど、私を頼らなくなったような気がする
records.en_original: And it's not just Leader—it's everyone. I get the feeling people don't rely on me as much as they used to.
records.en: And it's not just Leader—it's everyone.<CR>I get the feeling people don't rely on me as much as they used to.

records.jp: 私はもうリーダーではない。<CR>そういう機会が減るのは必然だ
records.en_original: I'm not calling the shots anymore. It's only natural those chances would decrease.
records.en: I'm not calling the shots anymore.<CR>It's only natural those chances would decrease.

records.jp: それはさ、メイが頼りないんじゃなくて、<CR>みんながリーダーを頼りにするようになったんだよ
records.en_original: It's not because you're unreliable, Mei. It's just that now, everyone has learned to rely on Leader.
records.en: It's not because you're unreliable, Mei.<CR>It's just that now, everyone has learned to rely on Leader.

records.jp: リーダーがバラバラだった私たちをまとめてくれて、<CR>クイーンをどんどん倒せるようになったから
records.en_original: Leader brought us all together when we were scattered, and now we can defeat Queen after Queen because of that.
records.en: Leader brought us all together when we were scattered,<CR>and now we can defeat Queen after Queen because of that.

records.jp: でも、誰もメイが頼りないだなんて思ってないよ
records.en_original: But no one thinks you're unreliable. Not at all.
records.en: But no one thinks you're unreliable. Not at all.

records.jp: 本当にそうだろうか……
records.en_original: Is that really true?
records.en: Is that really true?

records.jp: メイ、覚えてる？<CR>私が部隊に配属されたばかりの時のこと
records.en_original: Mei, do you remember? When I had just joined the squad.
records.en: Mei, do you remember?<CR>When I had just joined the squad.

records.jp: 私、自分が体力なかったり、<CR>立ち回りが下手なのすごく気にしてて
records.en_original: I was always worried because I wasn't strong physically and I wasn't very good at moving around in battle.
records.en: I was always worried because I wasn't strong physically<CR>and I wasn't very good at moving around in battle.

records.jp: すっかり自信なくして<CR>部隊を辞めようとしてたことあったでしょ？
records.en_original: I totally lost my confidence. There was even a time I thought about quitting.
records.en: I totally lost my confidence.<CR>There was even a time I thought about quitting.

records.jp: でもメイ、その時言ってくれたよね
records.en_original: But, Mei, you told me something back then.
records.en: But, Mei, you told me something back then.

records.jp: 物事の本質を見誤るな。私たちはなんのために<CR>戦っているんだ？　強さを誇示するためか？
records.en_original: "Don't lose sight of what's really important. Why do you think we fight? Is it to show off our strength?"
records.en: "Don't lose sight of what's really important.<CR>Why do you think we fight? Is it to show off our strength?"

records.jp: 大切な人だったり、夢だったり、それぞれの<CR>守りたいものを守るために戦っていたんじゃないのか
records.en_original: "We're fighting to protect the things that matter to us—someone important, our dreams, whatever it is each of us wants to protect."
records.en: "We're fighting to protect the things that matter to us—someone important,<CR>our dreams, whatever it is each of us wants to protect."

records.jp: 劣等感なんてつまらないものに囚われている暇が<CR>あったら……
records.en_original: "If you've got time to waste on something as pointless as an inferiority complex..."
records.en: "If you've got time to waste on something as pointless as an inferiority<CR>complex..."

records.jp: 自分ができることを見つめ直して、守りたいものを<CR>守るためにどう活かせるか考えろ
records.en_original: "Then take a good look at what you can do, and figure out how you can use it to protect what you care about."
records.en: "Then take a good look at what you can do,<CR>and figure out how you can use it to protect what you care about."

records.jp: あの時の言葉に、私は救われたんだよ。<CR>だからここまで頑張れた
records.en_original: Your words back then saved me. That's how I've made it this far.
records.en: Your words back then saved me.<CR>That's how I've made it this far.

records.jp: でも今のメイは……<CR>「つまらないもの」に囚われてる
records.en_original: But now, Mei...you're stuck on something "pointless" yourself.
records.en: But now, Mei...you're<CR>stuck on something "pointless" yourself.

records.jp: 私を救ってくれたメイは、<CR>そんな小さなこと気にしないはずだよ
records.en_original: The Mei who saved me wouldn't get hung up on such small things.
records.en: The Mei who saved me wouldn't<CR>get hung up on such small things.

records.jp: 何よりメイは、今のままで充分強い。<CR>何度も私やみんなを守ってくれた
records.en_original: And besides, you're already plenty strong. You've protected me and everyone else so many times.
records.en: And besides, you're already plenty strong.<CR>You've protected me and everyone else so many times.

records.jp: それは、バディの私が一番知ってる
records.en_original: As your partner, I know that better than anyone.
records.en: As your partner, I know that better than anyone.

records.jp: メイ、目を覚まして。<CR>戦ってる意味を思い出して
records.en_original: Snap out of it, Mei. Remember why we're fighting.
records.en: Snap out of it, Mei.<CR>Remember why we're fighting.

records.jp: ユキ……
records.en_original: Yuki...
records.en: Yuki...

records.jp: すまない。<CR>一時の気の迷いで心配をかけてしまった
records.en_original: Sorry. I made you worry over nothing, just because I lost myself for a moment.
records.en: Sorry.<CR>I made you worry over nothing, just because I lost myself for a moment.

records.jp: もう、大丈夫？
records.en_original: Are you all right now?
records.en: Are you all right now?

records.jp: ああ。もう気の迷いは晴れた
records.en_original: Yeah. The confusion has passed.
records.en: Yeah. The confusion has passed.

records.jp: 私が戦うのは、劣等感を払拭するためではない
records.en_original: I'm not fighting to erase my inferiority complex.
records.en: I'm not fighting to erase my inferiority complex.

records.jp: 仲間をこれ以上、誰一人死なせないためだ
records.en_original: I'm fighting so that I won't lose a single comrade ever again.
records.en: I'm fighting so that I won't lose a single comrade ever again.

records.jp: ありがとう、ユキ。<CR>素晴らしいバディを持てて、私は幸せ者だ
records.en_original: Thank you, Yuki. I'm lucky to have such a wonderful partner.
records.en: Thank you, Yuki.<CR>I'm lucky to have such a wonderful partner.

records.jp: あはは。<CR>私もメイのそういうところ、結構好きだよ
records.en_original: Ahaha. I actually really like that part of you too, Mei.
records.en: Ahaha.<CR>I actually really like that part of you too, Mei.

records.jp: あ、いたいた。<CR>きらら、こっち
records.en_original: Ah, there you are. Kirara, over here!
records.en: Ah, there you are.<CR>Kirara, over here!

records.jp: 二人とも、どうかしたの？
records.en_original: Is something up, you two?
records.en: Is something up, you two?

records.jp: わたしじゃなくて、きららがね。<CR>瀟に相談したいことがあるんだって
records.en_original: Not me—it's Kirara. She wants to talk to Meiqi about something.
records.en: Not me—it's Kirara.<CR>She wants to talk to Meiqi about something.

records.jp: 私に？
records.en_original: With me?
records.en: With me?

records.jp: 詩のことで、話がある。<CR>あいつは……危険な存在だ
records.en_original: It's about Uta. I need to talk to you. She's...a dangerous person.
records.en: It's about Uta. I need to talk to you.<CR>She's...a dangerous person.
